title: Cloudflare zone desired state
description: The zone and account posture bin/cloudflare.ts checks and applies. No account or zone IDs: both resolve at runtime from the zone name. See docs/Cloudflare.md.

zone.description: Zone name; the zone and its account are looked up by it.

owner.description: Ownership tag. Rules whose ref starts with '<owner>-' belong to this file; apply never edits or deletes any other rule.

settings.description: Zone settings by API setting id (PATCH /zones/:zone/settings/:id).

speed_brain.description: On: prefetches likely next pages through a speculation-rules response header, which adds no markup.

rocket_loader.description: Off: rewrites script tags, which breaks the hashed inline script.

email_obfuscation.description: Off: injects a decoder script into HTML.

automatic_https_rewrites.description: Off: rewrites HTML; every URL is already https.

browser_cache_ttl.description: 0 respects the origin's Cache-Control, so public/_headers decides browser TTLs.

preload.description: Pending a decision; preload is hard to undo.

botManagement.description: The zone's bot_management settings (PUT /zones/:zone/bot_management). The endpoint resets every field a PUT leaves out, so apply sends these over the live values of the fields not declared here.

enable_js.description: Off: JS Detections injects an inline script with per-request values, which no CSP hash can cover.

fight_mode.description: Off: Bot Fight Mode challenges visitors and turns JS Detections on.

ai_training.description: AI crawlers that collect content to train models.

ai_search.description: AI crawlers that index content for search.

ai_user.description: AI agents fetching a page for a person's request.

firewall.description: WAF custom rules (phase http_request_firewall_custom). The free plan allows 5; keep one free for incidents.

rateLimit.description: The free plan's one rate-limiting rule (phase http_ratelimit): path and verified-bot fields, per IP and colo, 10 s period and block.

pagesDevRedirect.description: Account Bulk Redirect closing the production pages.dev alias. Preview subdomains stay reachable (include_subdomains false).

pages.description: The Pages project. Its compatibility date is checked against tests/browser-test-env.ts, the one the edge suite runs.

previewAccess.description: An Access application covers the preview hostnames (Settings → General → Enable access policy).

previewPolicy.description: Every policy on the preview Access application is Service Auth whose include rules are service tokens only: previews are reached by CI's token and the tailnet proxy's, never by a person's identity. Check-only: apply never edits Access.

previewBranches.description: Branches that get a preview deployment. The dist branch holds built output, so it is excluded: a build of it would fail.

schemaValidation.description: API Shield schema validation for the contact endpoint. Block is the only action on the free plan.

turnstile.description: The Turnstile widget serving the zone, found by hostname.
